outcome: Composite adverse maternal outcome (postpartum morbidity and mortality)
cohort: 29,516 women from low- and middle-income countries who underwent intrapartum cesarean birth between 24 and 43 weeks gestation
finding: Maternal adverse outcomes were reduced in women with ≥ 4 antenatal visits, those who delivered in a medium or high human development index country, and those with malpresenting fetuses.
